items.title: Micron Could Be the Next Nvidia For Patient Investors
items.summary: Micron has already posted a 662% one-year gain on the AI memory boom, but our proprietary model puts its 12-month price target below where the stock trades today, and the reasoning challenges everything the bull case assumes.

items.title: Memory Stocks Slide as Rates and Oil Swamp JPMorgan’s Overweight Call: SK Hynix Sinks 5%, Western Digital Drops 3%, Micron Slips
items.summary: JPMorgan just slapped an Overweight rating on SK Hynix with a price target well above current levels, yet the stock is sinking anyway as surging Treasury yields and triple-digit oil prices gut the bull case in real time.

items.title: SanDisk Traded Its Best Prices For Something Rarer
items.summary: SanDisk (SNDK) shares changed hands at $70.50 a year ago. They now sit at $1,737.99. Flash prices rose over that stretch, and the whole memory group rose with them, so part of this is the cycle. The rest is what SanDisk did while it held the leverage, and that part comes with a bill.

items.title: STX Stock: The Math Hidden In Its Price
items.summary: This is a cyclical-peak chapter for Seagate Technology. The company sells mass-capacity hard drives, with cloud providers' data centers now representing the vast majority of its shipments.

items.title: Can SanDisk Stock Keep Climbing When It Cannot Make Enough To Sell?
items.summary: SanDisk (SNDK) finished fiscal 2026 with $20.2 billion in revenue, and its stock has returned roughly 2,700% over the past twelve months, while the shares still sit about 25% below their 52-week high. Anyone buying now is asking one question. What powers the next leg, when the company has already said it can only make so many more bits.
